'''1999 Decipher World Championship Final Confrontation''' was the Star Wars CCG World Championship final, played on 13 November 1999 at [[DecipherCon 1999]] in Virginia Beach, Virginia. [[Gary Carman]] beat [[Steven Lewis]]: Carman won game 1 by 22 with his Dark Side deck, and Lewis won game 2 by 3, so Carman took the title of the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="fc-g2h19">[http://calder.decipher.com/cgi-bin/msgbd?dconerb$25606-3231$1 "Star Wars CCG Final Confrontation, Game 2, Highlight 19"], Francis K. Lalumiere, DecipherCon: Event Report Board, Decipher (13 November 1999, 18:27). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001023183613/http://calder.decipher.com:80/cgi-bin/msgbd?dconerb$25606-3231$1 Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Francis Lalumiere|Francis K. Lalumiere]] covered the match live on Decipher's DecipherCon Event Report Board in 36 posts, from 16:51 to 18:27. The posts are transcribed below as he wrote them, including his spelling "Garry" for Carman.<ref name="fc-g1" />

'''Highlight 19''' (18:27)
<blockquote>Because of Security Precautions, Garry had to lose 8 Force when Steven probed his Hidden Base -- plus, Steven got back all of his probe cards.<br />
With the help of Lateral Damage, Executor takes out the Falcon, and Steven wins the game by 3.<br />
But Garry took game 1 by 22, and so Garry Carman becomes 1999's Star Wars CCG World Champion!<br />
Congratulations to both players.<ref name="fc-g2h19" /></blockquote>
